responsibility: Implements 32-bit ARM ABI classification for FnAbi, selecting between core-register passing and VFP homogeneous-aggregate passing based on target hard-float status, calling convention, and variadicity, while extending scalars and coercing aggregates to ARM-sized register forms or indirect passing.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/arm.rs`, this file handles ARM function-call ABI classification, including hard-float/VFP homogeneous-aggregate decisions and scalar/aggregate coercions, not inline-assembly register naming, modifiers, or reserved-register checks.
